title: Degree-zero restriction row with a certified product comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U,V\subseteq X$ quasi-compact opens [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].  Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(T,(f_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i$, let $F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $f:i\to j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(T_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $f_i^{-1}F_i$ by isomorphisms, its arrows being inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$, with coprojections $\iota_i$. Fix degree p=0. Let $H:I\to\operatorname{Ab}$ have specified object isomorphisms $e_i:H_i\cong H^p(D_i,F_i)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and arrows conjugate to $H^p(\varphi_f)\circ D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Let $B$ be a cocone on $H$ with an isomorphism $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(T,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$ such that, for every $i$, its leg $b_i$ satisfies $e\circ b_i=H^p(\iota_i)\circ f_i^*\circ e_i$, including the specified identification $G_i\cong f_i^{-1}F_i$. Fix an index $i_0\in I$ and an isomorphism $\epsilon:D_{i_0}\cong (U\cup V)$. Put $g=f_{i_0}$ followed by $\epsilon$ and the inclusion $U\cup V\to X$, and let $W_U=g^{-1}(U)$ and $W_V=g^{-1}(V)$. Put $Q=\varinjlim_I H_i$, with its canonical comparison $m:Q\to B_{\mathrm{pt}}$ induced by the cocone $B$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Put $B_4=H^p(W_U,L|_{W_U})\times H^p(W_V,L|_{W_V})$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and let $r':B_{\mathrm{pt}}\to B_4$ be the pair of canonical restriction maps after $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(T,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$.  There are a nonempty directed preorder J and a final functor t:J→I, a functor K4:J→Ab, a natural transformation r:t⋙H→K4, and a comparison v4:colim K4→B4 with a [def-weil-pbc-stage-cohomology-comparison] certificate for S=U or S=V or S=U∩V. Each r_j is injective. For every j, r_j followed by the coprojection and v4 equals the leg B_{t(j)} followed by r′. No left terms, cofinality isomorphism or whole-colimit square are asserted.

proof.text: Pass to the directed cofinal tail J above i0. Transfer the two opens by e and pull back each open to the stages and limit. isLimitOpensCone and isAffineHom_π_app supply the restricted scheme limits and affine projections. Restricted transitions remain affine; qc opens have compact inverse images, and the intersection is compact on the quasi-separated union stage. Restrict coefficients and their transitions; inverse-image composition gives coherence and its left adjoint property preserves the sheaf colimit.

Construct the degree-zero diagrams of the U and V restricted systems; form their product. Restriction naturality makes r natural and initial Mayer--Vietoris injectivity makes every r_j injective. The product of the two certified system comparisons, transported by filtered-product preservation, gives v4. Canonical cocone equations and hB give the square on each stage leg.
